name: Segment Stitch
description: Asks TheIntroDB and IntroDB and reads the item's chapters, then merges intros, recaps, credits and previews per segment type, so an episode can get its intro from one source and its credits from another. Where several sources have a type, the time they agree on is kept.
overview: Jellyfin media segments from TheIntroDB, IntroDB and chapters, merged per segment type.
